code_summary: Custom Path B wrapper around the incumbent FM+BPR+recency configuration that trains once with `capture_epoch_scores` enabled, robustly parses whatever score payload structure the training loop records per epoch, constructs candidate finalisation rules from those stored epoch predictions, uses `selection_rule_test` on held-out user splits of VALID to choose among rules out-of-sample, then emits the chosen valid/test score vectors.
